verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs claim an official backup-node sync service with end-to-end encryption where 'not even Anytype can see your content' (docs-31, docs-42, docs-43), and it does sync across desktop/mobile automatically. However, a co-founder's own comment concretely contradicts the full E2E claim, stating 'all your data lives unencrypted on-disk' and that 'only the indexes of this data are not encrypted' with plans to encrypt indexes 'in the future' — a documented gap between marketing and actual implementation at the time. Missing for 10: independent security audit confirming full E2E coverage including indexes, and confirmation the unencrypted-index issue has been resolved.
